mentions.name: 2D Space RTS
mentions.description: A 2D real-time strategy game with a fully orthogonal view set in space, featuring spaceship combat. Players deploy a base near a minable planet and build structures for mining two resource types, researching, and constructing ships. Development focuses on highly responsive controls inspired by StarCraft 2 and a ship design system inspired by Starsector: outside of battle, players define ship blueprints combining a hull with stat mounts, weapons, and built-in upgrades, then build those ships in-game. Built with Godot, with performance-critical logic implemented as C++ GDExtensions.
